visualRisks.description: Waterfront district has a potential navigation risk due to the lack of clear road markers or paths.
visualRisks.details: The path from row 3, column 15 to row 4, column 27 is unclear as there are no explicit road markers. The transition between ground and water could be confusing.

visualRisks.description: Some areas may appear too similar in color, leading to navigation issues.
visualRisks.details: The dock area (#98734e) shares a similar color with the ground (#283e35), which might cause confusion for players navigating through these areas.

navigationRisks.description: Potential pathfinding issues in certain areas.
navigationRisks.details: The route from row 17 to row 40 and then to row 52 has several turns that could be challenging, especially if the player is not familiar with the layout.

navigationRisks.description: Unclear end points or destinations within the district.
navigationRisks.details: The final destination at row 90 does not have any visual cues indicating its importance or purpose in the game.
